title: Perfect day with a perfect driver - thank you.
text: Our guide Udo was punctual and told us a lot about this beautiful city in four hours. He responded to our wishes, and we really enjoyed the tour. Thank you very much and anytime again
author: Sabine_E

title: Great Day Barcelona

author: Michael_G

title: Great way to see Barcelona in a short time
text: Excellent tour I would drive. It was very knowledgeable and we felt comfortable going around the city with him. He also brought us to a recommended spot for a local lunch, which was delicious.
author: Dominica_R

title: Great way to see all of Barcelona! Driver was on time and made it very convenient for us.
text: Everything was excellent. It was a great way to see all of Barcelona with only being here one day with a cruise ship. The driver picked us right up at the terminal and dropped us back off. Also provided us with a great lunch recommendation. I would highly recommend.
author: dominicar348

title: Great experience in every way.
text: The best experience ever.  Very informative with history of Barcelona the different areas we were in. Educational for my teen age grandchildren. Safe clean and very comfortable vehicle . Luxury safety interesting trip all over wonderful Barcelona. Thank you so much. Dorene B and family.
author: Dorene B

title: Javier personal tour of Barcelona
text: Very funny and knowledgeable! Was right on time (early even).  Put us right at ease.  Even had a good political knowledge.
author: Diane C

title: Wonderful experience with our drivers!
text: We used this service for our airport transfers to our hotel in Barcelona, as well as to and from our cruise ship at port. We also hired them for a private tour of Barcelona, as they were so personable and accommodating! We were a party of 7, with adults, teens, and young children, along with all of our luggage. We were able to fit everything comfortable, and always felt we were in very good hands. Our driver even came to meet us at the door of our hotel when transferring to the cruise ship ( our hotel was located on a pedestrian walkway). Do not hesitate to hire this service. They are reliable
author: Wonderbug22

title: Fantastic Experience
text: Xavier was great, showed us everything we wanted to see, and was great with information about the things we were seeing.  Communication was excellent and we would happily book with his company again.  Thank you so much.
author: rmyford1970

title: Great experience!
text: This was such a smooth process! Javier met us right at the port. He took us just where we requested and waited for us. He also gave us an overview of the city. He was open to just what we wanted to do. This was a great experience.
author: wvwfufan
